title: LLM Active Alignment: A Nash Equilibrium Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Computing Nash Equilibrium weights for LLM agents aligning with left-, center-, and right-leaning subpopulations (using the POLITICS dataset) to identify incentive configurations that lead to systemic political exclusion.

Calculating equilibrium alignment weights for geographic and cultural subpopulations (e.g., North America, Europe, Africa/Asia using the CultureBank dataset) to observe patterns of regional representation and exclusion.
Deriving equilibrium mixture weights for subpopulations based on the Big Five Personality Traits to determine which psychological profiles are systematically ignored by the LLM population.
